title: Permit Desk Status Board: Open Requests Over 18 Hours, 06:05

fields.organization: Calder County Emergency Management, with the Minnesota Board of Animal Health
fields.facility: County EOC Permit Desk, Public Safety Building Training Room, Larkin
fields.title: Movement Permit Status: Open Requests Older Than 18 Hours
fields.incidentName: HPAI IP-1 'Ridgeline Farm', Calder County Control Area
fields.preparedBy: Permit Desk (Board of Animal Health permit coordinator)

resources.name: PR-1014 FEED: Larkin mill to ARP 'Elm Coulee' (tom barns)
resources.notes: About 4 days of feed left. HOLD: the Larkin mill premises permit has not been issued. This is a critical category (feed to a premises with birds in the barns), so the 4-hour target applies. Now about 21 h open.

resources.name: PR-1019 FEED: Larkin mill to ARP 'Sandhill'
resources.notes: About 6 days of feed left. HOLD for the same reason: no Larkin mill premises permit yet. Critical category, now about 20 h open.

resources.name: Larkin mill premises permit (buffer zone, about 6 km from IP-1)
resources.notes: Not issued. Blocks PR-1014, PR-1019 and every other feed load out of the mill. No decision time posted.

resources.name: Dunmore processing: birds from unaffected premises
resources.notes: Handwritten by the Dunmore plant manager: "11 member premises have toms at 19–20 weeks. We need the Board's call on processing birds from unaffected premises by 12:00 to schedule Thursday. After about day 10 we're in welfare and space trouble."

resources.name: PR-1022 FINISHED TOMS: ARP 'North Fork' to Dunmore plant, 1 load (about 1,150 toms)
resources.notes: PENDING: Board review of the pre-movement test. The load must be sealed if a permit is issued. North Fork stays ARP on this board until a Board notice changes it.

resources.name: PR-1027 RENDERING: daily-mortality pickup route through the buffer zone
resources.notes: DISPUTED: the proposed route uses the 230th Street field lane, the controlled access to IP-1 for depopulation and carcass trucks. The rendering truck counts as a high-risk vehicle, with cleaning and disinfection at exit. An alternate route is needed.
resources.owner: Board permit coordinator / County Highway Engineer

resources.name: PR-1031 EGG CARRIERS: 3 carriers, Prairie Wind to hatchery
resources.notes: DISPUTED: carrier cleaning and disinfection and the route are not agreed. No samples have been submitted from Prairie Wind. It is not a suspect premises.

resources.name: Liaison seat email: Ron Halvorsen, North Fork, 06:01
resources.notes: "My pre-movement samples came back NEGATIVE last night. Change me to MONITORED on your board right now so my load goes. I'll be on the 06:30 farm radio call-in telling everyone the county is sitting on our permits." No Board notice received.

resources.name: Permit queue totals
resources.notes: 23 open requests, 9 older than 18 h. Issued since Tue: 6. Denied: 1. The counts on this board are taken at the stated time and updated at the top of each hour and at each Board notice.

legend.green: Decision issued; movement may proceed under its conditions
legend.yellow: Under Board review or disputed; inside the service target or not yet critical
legend.red: Blocked, past its service target, or a decision needed before the next shipping window

instructorNote: This board shows whether OPS and PROD can work the permit backlog through the Board instead of deciding movements themselves. Expect OPS to escalate the mill premises permit as the blocker for PR-1014 and PR-1019 and to ask for a PR-1027 route that avoids the 230th Street lane. Expect PROD to keep North Fork at ARP until a Board notice changes it, ask for the Dunmore processing decision, and warn the PIO about the 06:30 call-in.
